entries.8a20bffd3d354901: This is a product category shown separately as "Melamine Decorative Laminates" in the notes on [Revenue Recognition]; its revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥35,218 million, the largest category within Building Interior and Construction Materials. The management analysis states that in Japan, revenue exceeded the previous year as renovation demand in the non-residential market was won, and the flooring "Melamine Tile," a strategic product for opening new markets, also steadily increased its sales, while overseas, revenue fell below the previous year owing to factors such as the market slump in China.

entries.e8a3bfb35b5f05ae: This is the product category shown separately as "Adhesives" in the Revenue Recognition note, with net sales of ¥94,299 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026, the largest category within Chemical Products. The management analysis states that in Japan, sales exceeded the previous year, with woodworking and furniture adhesives, acrylic emulsions for textiles and paints, hot melts for packaging and others performing well, while overseas, sales grew in Vietnam, New Zealand and elsewhere but fell below the previous year owing to factors such as the market slump in China.
entries.f654a800c4d03026: This is the product category shown separately as "Adhesives" in the Revenue Recognition note, with net sales of ¥94,299 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026, the largest category within Chemical Products.
entries.f6d27ef1eafcc191: This is a product category shown separately as "Construction Resins" in the notes on [Revenue Recognition]; its revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,982 million. The management analysis states that revenue was slightly above the previous year: the colored floor coating "Jolyace" was weak due to a reaction to a large order in the previous year, while the exterior and interior finishing coating "Jolipat" increased, including for condominiums, and the "Tough Resin Clear Guard Method," a method for preventing exterior wall tiles from falling off, won renovation demand from condominiums, hotels and medical and welfare facilities.
entries.f7d2e784a7a74ff3: This is a product category shown separately as "Boards, Films, etc." in the notes on [Revenue Recognition]; its revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥12,038 million. The management analysis states that revenue fell below the previous year: the adhesive-backed decorative film "Ortino," whose lineup was expanded in the previous fiscal year, was strong, but general-purpose polyester decorative plywood and sheet plywood were weak.
entries.fb866d8f51876203: This is the product category shown separately as "Functional Materials" in the Revenue Recognition note, with net sales of ¥16,711 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026.
entries.fc7416381c62dc3b: This is a reportable segment that manufactures and sells exterior and interior finishing coatings, floor coatings, various adhesives, organic fine particles, and other products. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, net sales to external customers were ¥136,262 million (down 1.7% year on year), larger than Building Interior Materials (¥115,502 million), and segment profit (operating profit, before deduction of unallocable operating expenses) was ¥9,330 million. The securities report states as this segment's policy that it will pursue higher added value in resins for the construction field while growing in non-construction fields such as automobiles, daily necessities and electronic materials.
